importNotes: Id is omitted; let the database generate it.
LessonId is represented by lessonKey at group level; create or look up Lesson first, then assign its database Id during import.
Meaning is intentionally empty because the sources do not provide Vietnamese translations.
AudioUrl and example fields are null because source examples/audio are not provided.
meaningEnglishReference is optional metadata, not Vocabulary.Meaning.
Topics are heuristic labels inferred from English dictionary glosses and are not official HSK categories.
Levels 7-9 remain combined because both source datasets publish them as one band.
topicClassification: Keyword matching on CC-CEDICT English definitions; unmatched words use Khac / unclassified.
